entities.name: Fizz
entities.description: Goblin from an unknown plane recruited into a war against humans, who became a field chef.

events.summary: Fizz is recruited into the war against humans by Razgar, joins the 99th Goblin Infantry, then moves to the field kitchens for her talents.
events.quote: she soon found herself in the relative safety of the field kitchens

events.summary: Ordered to bring the General hot soup, Fizz dashes across the battlefield with the cauldron.
events.quote: she picked up the soup cauldron and left the relative safety of her tent behind

events.summary: In a human trench one human tastes her soup and dies; the other flees screaming of a chemical attack.
events.quote: One human tasted her soup and immediately died.

events.summary: Fizz reaches General Razgar and Yort by balloon; the soup is a hit and she is promoted to Field Chef, First Class.
events.quote: Fizz immediately got promoted to Field Chef, First Class

relations.note: recruited by and cooks for him
relations.quote: Fizz had been recruited into a war against the humans by the orc General Razgar
General Razgar and his adjutant, Yort
